task.ques: Browse for a compact air fryer on Amazon with a capacity of 2 to 3 quarts. It should have a digital display, auto shutoff and be priced under $100.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: The CHEFMAN 2 Qt Mini Air Fryer (Black, RJ38-2T-BLACK) meets your requirements at $42.43 on Amazon, before shipping and tax, checked October 27, 2026.

• Capacity: 2 quarts.
• Digital display: capacitive touch screen for cooking time and temperature.
• Auto shutoff: turns off when cooking finishes or the basket is removed.
• Compact size: 10 inches deep × 10 inches wide × 8.3 inches high.

Source: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DC11YH4J
Evidence: final.png shows the product name, price, capacity, display description, and automatic shutoff statement together on the Amazon product page. Search used Amazon's default Featured sort with no filters.
